hero.title: Document Intelligence for Banking
hero.subtitle: DocumentoIQ helps analyse, extract and organise information from banking files and documents, reducing review times while always keeping the final decision in the hands of the analyst.
hero.microcopy: Designed to understand documentation specific to the banking sector.

whatIs.title: Why a specialisation for banking?
whatIs.description: Banking files bring together contracts, applications, guarantees and regulatory documentation that require precise and consistent review. DocumentoIQ incorporates specialised document logic to organise that information and facilitate its analysis.
whatIs.disclaimer: DocumentoIQ assists document analysis; evaluation and the final decision always remain in the hands of the responsible team.

howItWorks.title: How does DocumentoIQ for Banking work?

step1.title: 1. Uploading files
step1.description: Upload banking files and documents from digital files, scanned documents, or integrations with other systems.

step2.title: 2. Specialised document analysis
step2.intro: DocumentoIQ identifies relevant information, organises content, and detects elements that require attention to facilitate review.

step3.title: 3. Review and validation
step3.description: The responsible team reviews the organised information, validates the results, and continues with its operational process.

benefits.title: What does DocumentoIQ bring to a financial institution?
benefits.description: DocumentoIQ combines document specialisation for banking with capabilities designed to integrate naturally into the organisation's processes.

business.title: Operational benefits
items: Keeps control in the hands of the responsible team
